insight: Raised a $250M Series B led by Sequoia and Spark in 2025 to build voice-first AI smart glasses.
name: Sesame
description: A conversational-speech company building lifelike voice companions — Maya and Miles — that interrupt, self-correct, and use natural pacing. The web demo lets you talk to them in real time, and Sesame has open-sourced its underlying CSM (Conversational Speech Model) base model. Co-founded by Oculus co-creator Brendan Iribe.

modelSupport.notes: First-party Conversational Speech Model; CSM-1B base released under Apache 2.0.

edge: Open-sourced its CSM-1B voice model under Apache 2.0 while keeping the viral Maya/Miles companions a hosted demo.
cons: Demo only; no production API yet
